remarks: Spacious 2 Br, 1.5 Bath sunny apartment close to everything! Well maintained, in great condition - Floors, Carpet, Cabinets, Tile, Marble, Thermostats, High End Steam Washer & Dryer. Large eat-in kitchen, living room, 1/2 bath and washer/dryer on main floor, 2 bedrooms and full bath on top floor. Off Street parking for one car, additional parking on the street. Convenient To I-95 and Route 7. Just steps to stores and SoNo Collection Mall. 2 Month Security. No Pets. No Smoking.
